checks.criterion: The SafeRoute command center loads with campus status, navigation, map, route planner, metrics, hazard reports, and emergency contacts
checks.name: saferoute-dashboard-loads
checks.evidence: Public preview dashboard loaded with header, ALL CLEAR campus status, map, planner, hazard panel, and emergency contacts.

checks.criterion: A student can calculate a safer route
checks.name: saferoute-calculates-route
checks.evidence: Route flow rendered route option cards with safety score, distance, walk time, and a recommended option.

checks.criterion: A student can start and complete walk mode
checks.name: saferoute-walk-mode-completes
checks.evidence: Active escort HUD showed destination and remaining time; I arrived safely completed the flow.

checks.criterion: A student can report a campus hazard
checks.name: saferoute-reports-campus-hazard
checks.evidence: Unique hazard submission closed the dialog and displayed the new report in recent campus reports.

checks.name: saferoute-dispatches-emergency
checks.evidence: Emergency modal dispatch completed and visible Campus dispatch notified confirmation appeared.

checks.criterion: Dashboard metrics and hazard data are usable
checks.name: saferoute-metrics-and-hazards-visible
checks.evidence: Metrics and recent reports rendered, including the Engineering Hall Poor lighting Medium baseline with the current description 'Path lighting is dim between the east doors and service road.'.

checks.name: saferoute-desktop-layout-usable
checks.evidence: At desktop width, map and planner remained side by side with readable controls and no clipping.

checks.criterion: Route planning API returns safe route options and rejects same locations

checks.evidence: Backend suite passed: route endpoint returned 200 with 3 options and same-location validation returned 422.

checks.criterion: Hazard reporting API persists and returns a newly created hazard
checks.name: test_tscheck_hazard_reporting.py
checks.evidence: Backend suite passed: created hazard returned an id/location and was retrievable by GET.

checks.name: test_tscheck_emergency_dispatch.py
checks.evidence: Backend suite passed: POST /api/safety/emergency returned 200 with Dispatched and ETA.
